sources.summary: Chiselled acoustic foam, hand-bent metal and interlocking rulers feature in an exhibition of stools created with single tools, presented by students from the Royal College of Art at London Design Festival. One Tool, One Stool is the culmination of an exercise undertaken by every design products master's student at the Royal College of Art (RCA). The post RCA design students exercise restraint in One Tool One Stool exhibition appeared first on Dezeen .
